title: Make certain warnings use a graphical message box
author: hikari-no-yume
body:
Similar to https://github.com/touchHLE/touchHLE/issues/398 but for warnings that we expect will cause the emulator to crash, before a crash actually happens. Some examples are:

* If the app's minimum iOS version is too high.
* If the app is encrypted.

This should reduce user confusion. It shouldn't be necessary to check the log to see that one has a “bad” app.

Like for https://github.com/touchHLE/touchHLE/issues/398 there should be a command-line flag to disable this for development (the flag can be shared).

comments.author: hikari-no-yume
comments.body: Oh, apparently the encryption one is already a hard failure? So that might get covered by #398.
